name: AI Search Block Log Tag
description: Adds AI-powered tag classification to AI Search Block log entries.
project_description: AI Search Block Log Tag classifies logged AI-search questions into a controlled, per-block tag vocabulary using a chat LLM. When a log row gets its answer, an entity_update hook queues it; on cron a queue worker sends the question plus that block's configured tag list to a (preferably fast, cheap) model with a prompt you control, and stores only the returned tags that match the configured set (case-insensitive) in a dedicated ai_search_block_log_tag table. Tagging is idempotent (it replaces a row's tags), enabled per block, and can be run in bulk over historical logs from an admin form. A Tag Statistics dashboard charts searches per day by tag and the distribution across tags for the current and previous month. Depends on AI Search Block Log.
